# Documents

This folder contains the raw extracted text chunks from the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of the Danish ADHD Database (ADHD-DATABASEN). The pages sequentially cover the reports' executive conclusions, indicator overviews, detailed regional and departmental performance tables for both child/youth and adult populations, educational outcome metrics, and methodology appendices. These chunks serve as the foundational source material for the wiki's synthesized entity and topic pages, preserving the exact wording, data tables, and steering committee commentary from the original PDFs.

## Pages

- [[adhd-2023-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and executive conclusions for the 2023 ADHD database annual report.
- [[adhd-2023-part-002]] — Indicator overview and overall national results table for the 2023 report.
- [[adhd-2023-part-003]] — Regional and departmental data tables for Indicator 1 (somatic examination) and the start of Indicator 2a.
- [[adhd-2023-part-004]] — Results, trend graphs, and data tables for Indicator 2a (clinical environmental observation for 0-5 year olds).
- [[adhd-2023-part-005]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 2b (diagnostic interview or environmental observation for 6-17 year olds).
- [[adhd-2023-part-006]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 3 (diagnostic conference with a specialist).
- [[adhd-2023-part-007]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 4 (coordinating network meeting) and Indicator 5 (psychoeducation).
- [[adhd-2023-part-008]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 6 (pharmacological treatment) and the start of result indicators 7a and 7b.
- [[adhd-2023-part-009]] — Educational outcome results (Indicators 7a and 7b), disease description, and data basis methodology.
- [[adhd-2023-part-010]] — Appendix 1 detailing the study population demographics and Appendix 2 listing revoked diagnostic pathways.
- [[adhd-2023-part-011]] — Appendix 3 covering calculation rules for population formation and Appendix 4 with regional comments.
- [[adhd-2024-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and conclusions for the 2024 ADHD database annual report, introducing adult data.
- [[adhd-2024-part-002]] — Indicator overview and overall national results table for the 2024 report, including new adult indicators.
- [[adhd-2024-part-003]] — Regional and departmental data tables for children and youth Indicator 1 (somatic examination).
- [[adhd-2024-part-004]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 2a (clinical environmental observation for 0-5 year olds).
- [[adhd-2024-part-005]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 2b (diagnostic interview or environmental observation for 6-17 year olds).
- [[adhd-2024-part-006]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 3 (diagnostic conference) and Indicator 4 (coordinating network meeting).
- [[adhd-2024-part-007]] — Results and data tables for Indicator 5 (psychoeducation) and Indicator 6 (pharmacological treatment).
- [[adhd-2024-part-008]] — Educational outcome results for Indicators 7a and 7b (passing the primary school leaving exam).
- [[adhd-2024-part-009]] — Discussion of educational outcomes and detailed results for adult Indicator 8 (psychoeducation).
- [[adhd-2024-part-010]] — Results and data tables for adult Indicator 9 (psychotherapy).
- [[adhd-2024-part-011]] — Results and data tables for adult Indicator 10 (assessment of social support needs).
- [[adhd-2024-part-012]] — Results for adult Indicator 11 (pharmacological treatment), disease description, and data basis methodology.
- [[adhd-2024-part-013]] — Steering committee members, Appendix 1 detailing the database population demographics, and start of Appendix 2.
- [[adhd-2024-part-014]] — Appendix 2 listing revoked diagnostic pathways and Appendix 3 covering calculation rules for populations.
- [[adhd-2024-part-015]] — Appendix 4 containing feedback and comments from regions and departments for the 2024 report.
